This '''[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]''' was member of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where he served as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], after he was spotted while spying on a [[Akira/Legends|nicillin farm]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] broke the [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate's]] neck.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The scout was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]], who also voiced [[Dilanni/Legends|Dilanni]] in the same episode.
